__1 having destructive anger; with unimpaired knowledge. 
__2 enraged like serpents; epithet of the Maruts.

-माय a. having multiform or versatile forms like a snake, showing a variety of colour and shape, such as Vṛtra. 
-मारकः, -मेदकः

__2 = °द्विष् q. v.

__2 N. of a plant (गन्धनाकुली.)

.]]

(-क्थः) N. of a country.

-हन् a. Killing serpents or Vṛtra, Garuḍa, Indra.
